name: Code-Mixed Conversational Offensive Speech Dataset
description: Benchmark for detecting offensive speech in code-mixed conversational social media dialogue.
reputation: Cited in research on code-mixed toxic/offensive language detection; used within that niche but not broadly adopted across mainstream benchmarks.
notes: Contains code-mixed conversational social-media text — annotation subjectivity, class imbalance, and limited language variety can affect results; relatively small and specialized (non-LLM) benchmark.
